status: Experimental V6 flat-list transaction requests and replay-verified commits qualified in Rust

contracts.request: Exact context, schema binding and base snapshot; static payload admission followed by separate atomic application with consecutive live guards
contracts.commit: Before-state plus canonical forward recipe and result editor values; replay derives result document, successor snapshot, inverse operations, relocation and summary
contracts.noops: Requests may include valid no-ops; commits reject unchanged recipes and redundant noncanonical operations; state-only commits are supported
contracts.limits: Count and payload preflight, symmetric JSON byte limits, indexed typed errors and whole-document result validation including untouched roots
contracts.compatibility: Older codecs are unchanged and V5 rejects list history even under relabelled envelopes; heading payload bytes remain unchanged apart from the explicit envelope version

coverage: All three list primitives, typed formats, Unicode and exact derived inverse replay through both boundaries
Mixed atomic reframe/splice/replace with explicit selection, pending formats and metadata
Fresh-context replay, exact durable commit equality, one-event undo/redo and Session V6 restoration
Late stale guard and full-document result-budget failure preserve state and redo
Binding, snapshot and operation-count precedence over invalid payloads
Indexed malformed payloads, unknown and duplicate fields, typed-property and ordinal errors
Rejection of wire-supplied inverses, maps and summaries
Exact input/output byte budgets and process-local context refusal
State-only commits, unchanged recipe rejection and redundant no-op rejection
Earlier heading behavior and V5 list refusal
developmentCorrections: Corrected new test calls to the existing owned Commit and TransactionOutcome APIs
